text:
Sam H: Heads-up  OrbitOps: Production Inference Playbook webinar locked for June 18. Need final social copy for X + LinkedIn, hero image, two short clips, and inbound routing RFC by EOD Thu.
Tina L: Timeline ok. Suggest X primary at 10:30 PT, LinkedIn main at 13:30 PT, with a T+24h reminder and a speaker thread on X.
Marco P: Schedule and rough copy here: https://docs.google.com/orbitops (tab: social). X short: "OrbitOps: production inference patterns that actually scale. Wed Jun 18  Register -> [link]"
Marco P: X thread opener option: "OrbitOps: how we keep 99th percentile latency stable while cutting token spend. TL;DR: batching, fallback routing, KV cache. Register -> [link]"
Tina L: LinkedIn long: "Join Redwood engineers for 'OrbitOps: Production Inference Playbook'  Practical patterns for latency SLOs, cost controls, and safe rollouts. Save your seat -> [link]"
Sam H: Routing rules draft: utm_campaign=orbitops_launch. If company_size>=150 OR job_title contains (Head|Director|VP|CPO|CTO) -> tag enterprise_lead & route to enterprise-sdr. If form_field=use_case contains 'regulated' -> add compliance_flag. Else -> tag inbound_webinar -> sdr-rotation. Include source_platform and utm_content fields.
Marco P: small CSV stub for CRM mapping:
```
email,first,last,company,company_size,job_title,utm_source,utm_campaign,lead_tag,priority
lee@example.com,Lee,Chang,Datacorp,420,Head of ML,x,orbitops_launch,enterprise_lead,high
```
martech-bot: Scheduler preview:
```
platform: x
publish_time: 2026-06-18T10:30:00-07:00
copy: "OrbitOps: production inference patterns that actually scale. Wed Jun 18 — Register -> [link]"
image: orbitops-hero-v1.png
utm: utm_source=x&utm_campaign=orbitops_launch&utm_content=variant_main
```
Tina L: Canary plan: seedlist=orbit-seed-4k at T-48h. Metric to go wide: register CTR >= 7% OR signups >= 1.8% of canary. Also test two headlines on X for 2 hours and auto-merge winner by register CTR.
Marco P: Asset specs: X hero 1600x900 gif or png, LinkedIn 1200x628. Clips: 20s tech highlight + 20s biz highlight. Provide alt text and clip transcripts.
Sam H: Engagement follow-up sequence: 1) immediate thank-you email + calendar link 2) 6h post-webinar X thread with 3 bullets + clip 3) 24h email with recording and short playbook PDF 4) LinkedIn article recap with speaker quotes.
SDR Ops: For routing payload include fields: email,company,company_size,job_title,utm_source,utm_campaign,lead_tag,priority,lead_notes. High-intent rule: company_size>=500 OR job_title contains 'VP|Head|Director' -> priority=high -> ping #sdr-enterprise with lead row.
Tina L: Add utm_content=variant_main/variant_thread and utm_medium=social. Also append audience tag (seed/dev/prod) for better attribution.
Marco P: I'll upload final creative and transcripts to the assets tab by Wed 11am PT. Filenames: orbitops-hero-v1.png, orbitops-clip-tech.mp4, orbitops-clip-biz.mp4.
Sam H: QA checklist before scheduling: 1) final copy locked in sheet 2) assets uploaded + alt text 3) UTMs appended and landing page records params 4) form test (email + company_size + use_case) 5) canary scheduled.
martech-bot: Canary created: id=canary-3711, audience=orbit-seed-4k, time=2026-06-16T10:30:00-07:00.
Tina L: Also want a tiny paid test for the canary ($200) targeted at dev audiences. If canary shows lift, scale budget.
SDR Ops: We'll prepare CSV mapping and webhook. Also include lead_reason derived from form answers so SDRs know context.
Marco P: One more creative note: include a single-line methodology blurb for the LP: 'Benchmarked across 4 GPUs, 3 sequence lengths.' helps credibility.
Sam H: Great. Once assets + UTMs are confirmed I'll hand scheduling to martech-bot. Ping here when canary results are in. :rocket:
